title: Digital Platform Strategist
paragraphs: I am a digital platform strategist with around 20 years of experience in the retail and F&B industries, owning everything from platform strategy and new business model discovery to A-to-Z execution.

Starting in 2010 with Galleria Department Store's digital strategy, I led enterprise-wide digital strategy and digital marketing. I have years of hands-on experience across web/app builds, social channel operations, and digital magazine content planning, and extended my e-commerce planning and build capabilities through the Galleria shopping mall renewal project. Through café and ice cream brand development and launch projects, I also grew my understanding of offline business and ability to plan and execute new business models.

In 2020, to adapt to a rapidly changing digital environment, I completed Sogang University's AI Big Data Innovation MBA, strengthening my expertise in data-driven decision-making and AI. At Hanwha Solutions during the same period, I joined the Galleria Digital Transformation strategy TF with McKinsey, internalizing consulting methodologies to structurally analyze DT initiatives and derive execution strategies.

At BR Korea, I planned and built the Baskin Robbins app from zero — achieving 1M downloads, #1 on the App Store, and the Grand Prix at the 2025 Smart App Awards within six months of launch. I designed the membership and reward program as a CEO-direct initiative and led the kiosk UX/UI revamp, earning Gold at the 2025 A.N.D AWARD F&B category.
strengthsTitle: My strength lies in a track record of owning the full cycle: strategy → execution → results.

strengths.label: Platform & commerce strategy
strengths.body: Established enterprise-wide platform strategies including Galleria's digital channel strategy, the Hanwha–McKinsey DT TF, and the Baskin Robbins app business case validation.

strengths.label: New BM discovery and launch
strengths.body: Directly planned and launched market-validated new businesses: EBA ICE CREAM, eight Beans&Berries café stores, G-Cash (paper → mobile gift card 90% conversion), and the Baskin Robbins app.

strengths.label: Data & AI-driven decisions
strengths.body: Connected data and AI to business decisions through analytical capability from an AI/Big-Data MBA and continuous learning programs such as the BR Korea AI Ambassador track.

strengths.label: Cross-functional collaboration
strengths.body: Persuaded organizations with diverging interests — HQ, franchisees, IT, marketing — to align on shared goals, and drove ambiguous environments through to delivery.

strengths.label: Omnichannel & membership design
strengths.body: Designed unified-asset structures for online/offline customer data, from Galleria App Card and G-Cash to Baskin Robbins membership.

closing: With deep domain expertise across retail, F&B, and e-commerce, paired with consulting methodology, hands-on execution, and data/AI-driven decision-making, I design customer experiences and business models for the AX (AI Transformation) era — beyond DX.
